title: Shared Templates
description: Index of the shared source templates stored under /etc/vscode/Code4iRepo. Each template is also loadable as a dynamic VS Code snippet, triggered by its prefix.

name.title: Name
name.description: The display name of the template.

description.title: Description
description.description: A short description of what this template is for.

prefix.title: Prefix
prefix.description: Typed to trigger the snippet completion.

file.title: File
file.description: The filename of the source file inside /etc/vscode/Code4iRepo.

extensions.title: Extensions
extensions.description: File extensions / languageIds the snippet completion triggers on, e.g. ["rpgle", "sqlrpgle"].
